Added commit 79822fd — reschedule follows date ownership + auto-schedule confirms first:

- `computeProjectRescheduleDetailed`: under `summaryExtent: 'self'`, an own-dates unlocked summary now shifts like a task and carries its unlocked subtree (group-drag semantics, 顺延-only max rule for descendants pushed further by their own links); locked violators are reported in `skippedLocked`; `snapStart` hook snaps pushed starts onto shift-band boundaries. Back-compat wrapper keeps the old signature.
- Toolbar auto-schedule now confirms before the bulk write ("shift N task(s)? (M locked skipped)") and shows a transient "nothing to reschedule" notice on a clean graph; the post-drag conflict cascade shares the same semantics.
- Verified live on the 4-level tree: cancel leaves the DB untouched; confirm pushed a child-bearing plan +10d (band-snapped, duration kept), cascaded its successor, and left locked dispatch children and the predecessor in place. Suite: 335 green (12 new).

Added commit 427d684 — export fixes: (1) the PNG/PDF export drew phantom rollup bars on pure grouping rows (type 'group') that the live chart renders bar-less; the export loop now mirrors the group branch and skips them. (2) Filenames upgraded from opaque `gantt-week.png` to `<base>-<yyyyMMdd-HHmm>.<ext>`, base from the new `gantt.exportFileName` view config (host schemas reach the component stripped of `label`), falling back to object label → API name. Verified live: exported image clean, filename renders as 排班计划甘特图-20260719-0642.png.

Added commit 561532a7e — exported bars now carry their in-bar titles (条上标题) like the live chart: summary bars show the plan title, leaf bars the executor label, ellipsis-truncated to bar width (CJK-aware width estimate); narrow leaf bars fall back to the progress number. Verified live against the 4-level tree.

Added commit f4213bb70 — business-time-zone rendering: new `gantt.timeZone` (IANA) renders shift bands / day columns / snapping / today line / date labels in the configured zone's wall time for every viewer via a shifted-clock shim (writes translate back to real instants; DST-safe per-instant offsets; invalid names fall back with a warning; omitted = unchanged behavior). Live-verified from a UTC-7 browser against Asia/Shanghai: dates read Beijing, bar edges align pixel-exact to the 白班 band, and a +1-band drag persists exactly 7/20 20:00 → 7/24 08:00 Beijing. 340 tests green.
